vocabulary.meaning_en: a planned time when people who work together talk about something important
vocabulary.example: We have a meeting at 10 a.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when people who have not seen each other for a long time meet again
vocabulary.note_en: a family reunion, a school reunion
vocabulary.example: We had a family reunion after ten years.

vocabulary.meaning_en: things are happening in the normal way
vocabulary.example: Even after the storm, it was business as usual at the shop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to suggest what someone should do
vocabulary.example: I advise you to take the medicine.

vocabulary.note_ar: تُنطق بصوت s: /ədˈvaɪs/، وهي غير معدودة: some advice
vocabulary.note_en: Ends with an s sound; uncountable: some advice.
vocabulary.example: Can you give me some advice?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to reach a conclusion from evidence
vocabulary.example: From the wax on the floor, I infer that he had a candle.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to suggest something without saying it directly
vocabulary.example: Are you trying to imply that I'm lazy?

vocabulary.meaning_en: next to; at the side of
vocabulary.example: The marker is beside the bottle.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in addition to; as well; apart from
vocabulary.example: Besides going to work, how do you help the company?

vocabulary.meaning_en: difficult; solid (not soft); with a lot of effort
vocabulary.example: The test was hard. He works hard.
That hardly means you should get more money.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the second of two; the end part of something
vocabulary.note_ar: حرفا t = معنيان: الثاني، والجزء الأخير
vocabulary.note_en: Two t's: the second one, or the end part.
vocabulary.example: The latter half of the film was boring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: after the usual or present time; comparative of late
vocabulary.example: I stay later than everyone else.
This cake is made with eggs, milk and butter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the material something is made from
vocabulary.note_en: Also: made from (when the material changes, e.g. cheese from milk).
vocabulary.example: This sweater is made of cotton.

vocabulary.meaning_en: who or what process made it
vocabulary.example: This chair was made by hand.

fine_lines.title: advise vs advice
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advise فعل (ينصح) ويُنطق بصوت z. advice اسم (نصيحة) ويُنطق بصوت s، وهو غير معدود.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Advise is a verb (z sound). Advice is a noun (s sound) and uncountable.

examples.sentence: I advise you to save money.

fine_lines.title: beside vs besides
fine_lines.explanation_en: Beside = next to. Besides = in addition to.

fine_lines.title: hard vs hardly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: hard = صعب أو بجدّ. hardly = بالكاد، أي معنى قريب من النفي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Hard = difficult, or with effort. Hardly = almost not.

fine_lines.title: latter vs later
fine_lines.explanation_ar: latter = الثاني من اثنين أو الجزء الأخير. later = لاحقًا أو أكثر تأخرًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Latter = the second of two, or the end part. Later = after now, or more late.

examples.sentence: Tea or coffee? I prefer the latter.

fine_lines.title: meeting vs reunion
fine_lines.explanation_ar: meeting اجتماع منتظم لأشخاص يلتقون عادة للعمل. reunion لقاء أشخاص لم يلتقوا منذ زمن طويل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A meeting is for people who meet regularly, often for work. A reunion is for people who haven't met for a long time.

examples.sentence: The team meeting is on Monday.
Our class reunion is next month.

expressions.phrase: Can you give me some advice?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تعطيني بعض النصائح؟
expressions.meaning_en: Please suggest what I should do.
expressions.example: Can you give me some advice about my CV?

expressions.phrase: Are you trying to imply that...?
expressions.example: Are you trying to imply that I'm late every day?

expressions.meaning_en: the second half; the end part
expressions.example: The latter half of the meeting was more useful.

grammar.title: made with / made of / made by
grammar.explanation_ar: made with للمكوّنات (كعكة بالبيض والحليب). made of للمادة التي صُنع منها الشيء (قميص من القطن). made by لمن صنعه أو طريقة صنعه.
grammar.explanation_en: Made with = ingredients. Made of = the material. Made by = who or how.
examples: The soup is made with tomatoes and onions.
The table is made of wood.
This bag was made by my grandmother.

questions.question: "Hey James, can you give me some ___?"
questions.explanation_en: After "some" we need the noun advice.

questions.question: "___ going to work, how do you help the company?" (in addition to)
"I stay ___ than everyone else."
questions.explanation_en: Later is the comparative of late.

questions.question: "That ___ means you should get more money if you don't work." (not significant)
"Are you trying to ___ that I'm lazy?" (say indirectly)
People from the same school meet after 20 years. This is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A reunion is after a long time.

questions.question: "Tea or coffee? I'll have the ___." (the second one)
"The cake is made ___ eggs, milk and butter." (ingredients)
